 start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(); t=time.monotonic()
 r=subprocess.run([str(a) for a in args],cwd=cwd,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=240)

 (out/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print(label,r.returncode,flush=True)

for tool,version in [('python','3.12.11'),('node','22.23.1'),('uv','0.9.11')]:

key=run('source-key',['sh','-c',"printf '%s' \"$1\" | cksum | cut -d ' ' -f 1",'sh',engine]).stdout.decode().strip()
runtime=home/('source-'+key)
run('seed-runtime',['cp','-cR',seed/'source-314425025',runtime])
